description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class for managing account number formats within the Apache Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving templates, listing, retrieving individual formats, creating, updating, and deleting account number formats. The class is annotated for Swagger documentation and uses JAX-RS annotations for HTTP method and path mappings.

classes.name: AccountNumberFormatsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing account number formats, including CRUD operations and templates.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Returns a template for creating or updating account number formats, including default fields and allowed values.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Lists all account number formats, with optional field selection.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific account number format by ID, optionally including a template overlay.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new account number format based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing account number format with provided JSON data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an account number format by ID.
